conventions.convention: Tensor powers are left-associated: P₀(X)=1, P₁(X)=X, Pₘ₊₁(X)=Pₘ(X)⊗X. The positive Artin generator acts by the adjacent c(X,X), transported through associators and unitors without permuting spectator factors. Diagrams read upward, with the right input passing over the left.

The anyonic path space is Hom(c,Tₙ), with T₀=b and Tⱼ₊₁=Tⱼ⊗a. Every spectator and vertex multiplicity coordinate is retained. The vacuum-channel normalization uses the supplied sign κₐ∈{+1,−1}, positive dimension dₐ, and signed loop parameter δₐ=κₐdₐ.

Endomorphism multiplication is composition. Both adjacent Temperley–Lieb relations are assumed, δ=q+q⁻¹ with q≠0, and Bᵢ=qI−Uᵢ. The generic Hecke normalization is (Tᵢ−v)(Tᵢ+1)=0; the represented specialization is v=q² with Tᵢ↦qBᵢ.

Complex inner products are linear in their first variable. Unitarity of the constructed Bᵢ is conditional on bounded self-adjoint Uᵢ and |q|=1; categorical braid data alone assert no physical realization.
At q=1 the loop parameter is δ=2 and Bᵢ=I−Uᵢ. The canonical braid quotient sends σᵢ to the adjacent transposition in the supplier's transported indexing convention.

The listed channel scalars are eigenvalues only when their corresponding range or kernel subspace is nonzero. The cup-cap diagram represents Uᵢ=δₐPᵢ algebraically and asserts no physical particle trajectory.

load_bearing.statement: For n≥2, a complex vector space V, and endomorphisms U₁,…,Uₙ₋₁ satisfying both adjacent Temperley–Lieb relations, distant commutation, and Uᵢ²=δUᵢ with δ=q+q⁻¹ and q≠0, Bᵢ=qI−Uᵢ is invertible with inverse q⁻¹I−Uᵢ, satisfies the braid relations and (Bᵢ−qI)(Bᵢ+q⁻¹I)=0, and defines a braid-group representation. The specialization H(q²)(n) has a unital representation Tᵢ↦qBᵢ. On a complex Hilbert space, bounded self-adjoint Uᵢ, real δ, and |q|=1 imply unitary Bᵢ.

In a unitary spherical fusion category over C, let a,b,c be simple, with a self-dual, N(aa;1)=1, and supplied normalized vacuum-channel self-duality datum with sign κₐ and positive dimension dₐ. On H(a,n;b,c), n≥3, put Uᵢ=δₐPᵢ with δₐ=κₐdₐ. Then Uᵢ₊₁UᵢUᵢ₊₁=Uᵢ₊₁ for every 1≤i≤n−2.

For the stated locally finite k-linear abelian rigid monoidal category with bilinear tensor product, End(1)≅k, braiding, and object X, the rebracketed adjacent braidings Bᵢˣ are independent of the canonical rebracketing path and determine a homomorphism Bₙ→Aut(Pₙ(X)) sending σᵢ to Bᵢˣ.
